headline: Perimeter Solutions, SA (PRM) Lags Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Perimeter Solutions, SA (PRM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -18.61% and -2.95%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
